Results.ReviewText:
Weber Spirit E310 BBQ Review

I'm extremely impressed with the Weber Spirit E310 BBQ. The build quality is outstanding, far superior to the entry-level grills I've owned in the past. It's much heavier and feels more solid, which speaks to the excellent material quality used in its construction.

One feature I particularly appreciate is the propane tank gauge. It's a simple but incredibly useful addition that takes the guesswork out of knowing when to refill the tank. The even heat distribution across the grill is another highlight, ensuring that everything cooks consistently, which is a significant upgrade from my previous grills.

The electronic start is reliable and makes firing up the BBQ a breeze every time. Overall, I'm very happy with this purchase. It’s a top-notch grill that I would wholeheartedly recommend to anyone looking for a high-quality BBQ. If a friend asked me, I'd tell them to go for it!

Results.ReviewText: I have owned a number of Weber Grills over the years, starting with a charcoal kettle grill. One of the things that I have been most impressed with all of my grills is the rigid steel construction and heavier weight of the overall grill and carts. This particular grill has been quite the opposite. I really do not care for the cheaply made cart and light weight feel of the lid and grill box. This grill, so far, has been a disappointment. I bought it at one of the "Big Box" stores and paid extra for assembly. The personnel at the warehouse must have been in a hurry and left off both of the metal back covers. This makes the cart flimsy and feel like a number of the lesser priced "knockoff" grills. I immediately reported the issue to Weber (4-6 weeks ago) and was assured that I would be getting both of the missing parts within 7-11 days. So far I have only received the smaller of the two parts. A follow-up by me 7-10 days ago was met with a reassurance that I would be getting the missing part and I just needed to be "patient." Well so far no panel and my patience is all by evaporated. It's truly sad that yet another "benchmark" company has elected to make their products below standards and no longer a cut above the competition.
Results.Title: Disappointment

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
